git commit -m "$(cat <<'MSG'
fix lifecycle races and worker timeouts

Fullscreen now keeps the AX worker to the mutation only. The focus wait before and the display settling after run outside the 150ms window with a separate 1.5s deadline, so a successful transition no longer times out.

Workspace creation is serialized. Only one Space creation is in flight at a time and new requests queue in FIFO order. Binding now sorts candidates by position and claims each new Space once, so rapid alt-2 then alt-3 cannot swap identities. Persistent recreation waits when a dynamic creation is pending.

Closing a window no longer fabricates a snapshot that deletes it from the BSP. It marks the window pending close, excludes it from the next placement for an instant retile, and keeps the tree until observation confirms the window is gone. If the app shows an unsaved prompt the window stays and is tiled again next cycle.

Destroying an empty dynamic workspace now keeps the workspace and layout pending until the Space is actually gone. Failures clear the pending entry so the next cycle can retry instead of leaking a desktop. The same guard applies to system and fullscreen spaces.

Minimized is now conservative again. Unknown is treated as not tileable and falls back to the last known value, or not minimized for new windows. The AX timeout is back to 500ms and the SLS level fallback only covers managed. This stops minimized windows from stealing tiles when AX misses its deadline.

Verified with fmt, clippy and 168 tests. The dynamic destroy test now checks pending then confirmed removal.
MSG
)"
